import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a bar chart to compare the distribution of sleep duration across different gender groups
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', data=sleep_health, hue='Quality of Sleep', ax=ax)
ax.set_title('Sleep Duration by Gender and Quality of Sleep')
ax.set_xlabel('Gender')
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax.legend(title='Quality of Sleep')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
